So I bought 2 pairs, one black, one brown, for $91. while there I overheard the workers saying they had a AAA discount worth 20% on odd number purchases that was available at the Info Kiosk. My BOGO was a better deal since I was buying 2 pairs.

 

We then went across the lane to another store and lo and behold they had the exact Birkenstock sandal I wanted for only $89!!! But they did not have my size in the store. The man working there said they could order them and I'd get free shipping to my house. While being run up I remembered about the AAA discount at the other store and asked if they had anything similar, he said yes, and it was worth $5 off! So finished up and left.

 

Went to a 3rd store and Shelley bought a shirt. While she was doing that I started to reevaluate my now having 3 pairs of sandals that I really didn't need and that I'd enjoy it more if I realized the savings from the $130 down to $89 for my Birkenstocks. Shelley saw it on my face and said "you're going to return them aren't you?" LOL. I said yes, and we discussed keeping the brown pair since that would be nice to have a black and a brown.

 

I remembered about the AAA discount from the Info Kiosk (since I was now going to have 1 pair, not 2, to "buy" after the return of the black pair). We went to the Kiosk and got the coupon flyer, and I asked the lady there if the 2nd store (where I ordered the Birkenstocks from) had a discount in they flyer. She said yes, but there was a BETTER one on a separate coupon on the nearby table - this one was for $10 off!. LOL. So I picked up that coupon too. Then Shelley asked if there was a coupon for the store she bought the shirt from - YES and it was 25% off, LOL.

 

So back to the 1st shoe store, returned the black pair, applied the AAA 20% discount and got the brown pair for $45.

Then to the 2nd store, asked them if I could apply the new $10 coupon to my order instead of the $5 coupon - they did, so now the price was down to $84.

Then to Shelley's store, where they honored the 25% coupon on her new shirt.

Saved over $50 and got more than what I originally wanted.
